title: Police Arrest Man At His Job After Fleeing Scene Of Crash
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On October 11th, 2023. Deputies responded to the scene of a crash on which the suspect had hit a truck after trying to make an illegal turn. The suspect refused to give the victim his drivers license and insurance and fled the scene. The deputy was able to track him down to his job. The man gave his version of the story which he tried to put the blame on the victim, he stated that the man crashed into the rear of his vehicle but the damages don’t align with his statement. When the deputy asked him why he didn’t say on the scene of the crash he said he didn’t know how this all worked and that he’s new to Florida. It was also discovered that the man did not have FL drivers license but he had a Massachusetts DL that been expired for quite awhile. This is the body cam footage of the events that followed.

#news #police #arrest
